instruction:
Use the ANSYS Workbench GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: pin-ended compression column, linear buckling analysis.

Model parameters:
- Line body length 1000 mm
- Section: rectangle 10 mm x 10 mm
- Material: Structural Steel

Boundary conditions:
- Bottom end: pin support (displacement constrained)
- Top end: pin support (allow axial displacement)
- Top end: unit axial compressive load 1 N

Analysis type: eigenvalue buckling analysis, extract first buckling mode

Save requirements:
- Workbench project file: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wb_buckling.wbpj
- The project directory must include buckling analysis results
